title: manifest
passage_html:
This post contains ideas and band-9 sample answers (audio included) for the Cambridge IELTS 9 Academic Speaking Part 1 Question 4 Test 4 question:

“What are the advantages of a bicycle compared to a car? [Why?]”

Sample 1

One significant advantage of bicycles over cars is their contribution to our health and fitness. When you cycle, you’re not just moving from one place to another; you’re also giving your body a good workout. It’s a form of exercise that you can conveniently integrate into your daily routine.

Sample 2

One notable benefit of using a bicycle over a car is indisputably the financial aspect. Bicycles demand a much lower initial investment, and their upkeep is relatively inexpensive. There’s no need for fuel, insurance, or costly repairs, making it a more budget-friendly option. This cost-effectiveness can significantly improve one’s financial well-being over time.

Sample 3

In my opinion, cycling trumps driving in terms of environmental impact. Bikes produce zero emissions, which makes them a more eco-friendly option. This decision contributes to the fight against climate change and helps maintain our planet’s health.

Sample 4

I believe bicycling, unlike driving, is a stress-relieving activity. The fresh air and physical activity associated with cycling can help reduce anxiety and improve mood. Cars, on the other hand, often involve dealing with traffic and road rage, which can be quite stressful.

Sample 5

Cycling allows for more opportunities to engage with your local community. On a bicycle, one can take the time to enjoy the surroundings, stop at local shops, and interact with people more freely. In contrast, cars often isolate us inside a metal box, making social interactions less likely.

Sample 6

In my view, bicycles are much more space-efficient than cars. They require less road space, and this could lead to less congested streets and more room for pedestrians. Cars, however, take up a significant amount of space which contributes to crowded roads and parking issues.

Sample 7

I firmly believe in embracing a slow-paced life, and cycling fits perfectly into this philosophy. It gives me the chance to slow down, appreciate the journey, and take in the beauty of my surroundings. Driving, on the other hand, often feels rushed and doesn’t allow for the same reflective moments.

Sample 8

When it comes to commuting in city centers, bicycles often have the edge over cars. They can navigate through traffic more easily, and finding a parking space is never an issue. Cars, though faster on paper, often get stuck in traffic jams.

Sample 9

The advantage of owning a bicycle over a car is its simplicity of maintenance. A bicycle does not require regular oil changes, filter replacements, or engine checks. This simplicity not only saves money but also time and effort, making it a more practical choice for many.

Sample 10

From my perspective, bicycles contribute significantly less to noise pollution compared to cars. In bustling urban areas where the constant hum of vehicle engines can be overwhelming, choosing to cycle can contribute to a quieter, more enjoyable city atmosphere.
